description:
Cast Seething Song by paying {2}{R}.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping it, adding {U} or {R}.
Activate Nivix Guildmage's second ability by paying {2}{U}{R}, copying Seething Song.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the copy of Seething Song, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.
